Conditions, normalization, time-scale coincidences and single-cycle boundary are explicit. A reproducible program passed 114 finite comparisons.

originality.rationale: The originating paper arXiv:2508.16866 gives the model, covariance evolution and mean work but explicitly proposes higher-moment/fluctuation study. Paneru et al. arXiv:1911.09833 had previously treated passive full-shift work histograms and lower moments; these special cases are excluded. The focused contribution is a complete parameter-calibrated single-cycle density and signed-work asymmetry for arbitrary gain with colored Gaussian active forcing and an explicit finite-period covariance. The variance-gamma mathematical class is classical; risk of implicit coverage in earlier general formulas remains.
residual_risks: Gaussian quadratic-form theory mathematically implies Bessel-K0 distributions once the model-specific covariance and quadratic work kernel are supplied; the specialization may be viewed as an implicit corollary in broader literature.
Passive g=1 work histograms, variance, and symmetric noise threshold are established by Paneru et al. 2020 and are explicitly not novel.
Full text of arXiv:1911.09835 and all supplementary/related thermodynamic works was not exhaustively inspected; no unsupported whole-document noncoverage claim is made.
